4 انقدهُ (S, A, L, Msb, K) and ↓ استنفدهُ (A, L, K) and ↓ انتفده (K) He caused it to pass away or come to an end; spent, exhausted, or consumed, it; caused it to fail entirely; caused it to cease; made an end of it. (S, A, L, Msb, K.) ―
-b2- انفدوا مَا عِنْدَهُمْ, and ↓ استنفدوهُ , They spent, exhausted, or consumed, what they had. (A, L.) ―
-b3- وُسْعَهُ ↓ استنفد He spent, exhausted, or exerted, to the utmost his ability or power (S, L, Msb.) ―
-b4- انفد الَقْوُم The people came to that state that their travelling-provisions were exhausted, or had come to an end: (S, A, L, K:) or, (in the K, and,) their property had passed away and come to an end. (S, L, K.) ―
-b5- انفدت الرَّكِيَّةُ The well lost its water. (L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
